title: GET /api/auth/me/fe-permissions returns the expected wrapper shape
preconds: Build with CRP-BE-06 deployed. Authenticated as any user.
steps:
1. Hit GET /api/auth/me/fe-permissions with a valid session.
2. Inspect the response status.
3. Inspect the JSON body keys at the top level.
4. Inspect each key's type.
5. For fePermissions[]: confirm it is an array of strings, each matching one of the canonical bundle codes (WORK_ORDERS_VIEW, INVOICING_EDIT, SEE_FINANCIAL_DATA, SETTINGS_APP, etc.).
6. For viewMode: confirm it is one of 'tech' or 'full'.
7. For crossToggles: confirm it has the 3 expected boolean keys (seeFinancialData, seeApArData, viewHistoryLogs).
expected: Status 200. Body shape: { fePermissions: string[], viewMode: 'tech'|'full', crossToggles: { seeFinancialData: bool, seeApArData: bool, viewHistoryLogs: bool } }. All bundle codes in fePermissions match the canonical set from tech plan §3a. Tech plan flagged this as a NEW wrapper — the legacy endpoint returned only the flat list.
